metadata.description: Third-party plugins installed straight from their upstream repos, so every upstream release reaches this toolkit without waiting for a curated marketplace to re-pin it.

plugins.name: unreal-engine-skills-for-claude-code
plugins.description: Epic Games' Unreal Engine skills (unreal-mcp, unreal-skill, create-toolset) and SessionStart project hook for driving Unreal Editor over its MCP server.

plugins.name: firecrawl
plugins.description: Firecrawl skills for searching, scraping, crawling and interacting with the web through the Firecrawl CLI, skills for building Firecrawl into apps, and the Firecrawl MCP server config. With an API key, search also finds Firecrawl Alexandria data APIs and indexes for structured data.
